item.title: Ice Spice Stars in Spicy Wendy’s Ad Following McDonald’s Scuffle: Watch
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest update in the world of celebrity endorsements. Bronx rapper Ice Spice is making headlines again, but this time it's not for a viral altercation. She's partnered with Wendy's to promote their new spicy chicken sandwich. Let's dive in."
[Music transitions to a upbeat tune]
Host: "Ice Spice, aka 'Ice Spicy', stars in the new ad, showcasing the upgraded spicy chicken sandwich. The 26-year-old rapper even got a new icy chain to match her alias, and some fresh ink to commemorate the branding makeover."
[Audio clip from the ad plays: "New upgraded spicy chicken, only at Wendy's. Spice recognize spice."]
Host: "The partnership seems to be a hit with her fans, known as the 'Spice Cabinet'. They're loving the collab, with one fan writing 'The collab we needed, now you see how McDonald's don't got anybody? Wendy's is the best to ever do it'."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "This isn't the first time Ice Spice has mentioned Wendy's. Last month, she was involved in a physical altercation at a McDonald's in Hollywood, and later joked that 'this wouldn't happen at Wendy's'. It looks like she's putting her money where her mouth is, and teaming up with the rival fast-food chain."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Check out Ice Spice's new ad for Wendy's and let us know what you think. Thanks for tuning in!"
